title: eludite.resx.remove input
description: Remove keys from a resource set, as the editor's Delete does (proposal 0005): each key's entry is removed from the neutral file and from every culture file that has one. Class edit_buffer, under the policy's `resx.remove` (`prompt` by default for agents, since the entries and their translations are gone). The designer file is regenerated.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous for an agent when the solution's policy sets `resx.remove` to `prompt` (the default), refused when `deny`; `allow` leaves it at class edit_buffer.

set.description: The resource set: the path of its neutral `.resx` file (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder), or of any of its culture files, which names the same set.
